headlines.headline: ICICI Bank Q2 results: Profit rises 20% YoY to ₹14,843 crore, NIM down 12 basis points; asset quality improves
headlines.summary: ICICI Bank posted a 20% rise in its September quarter profits for FY27 with key support from the lender's rising interest income. Key factors like improvement in asset quality and a marginal fall in the margins will remain in focus of investors.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank Q2 earnings: Net profit rises 5% to ₹19,510 crore, NII advances 10%; Asset quality improves
headlines.summary: HDFC Bank's net interest income or the difference between interest earned on loans and expended on deposits rose 10% to ₹34,619 crore at the end of the second quarter.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms IPO: Here's how to apply under Reliance Industries shareholders’ quota
headlines.summary: Jio Platforms IPO has reserved around 12% of total issue or ₹2,500 crore for eligible Reliance Industries shareholders. Investors who held even one share of Reliance Industries on or before October 14, 2026 are eligible to apply under this category.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank Q2 results: Net profit likely to remain flat despite strong loan growth; key focus on NIM and leadership transition

headlines.headline: Jio vs Airtel: How do two telecom giants fare on key metrics against each other ahead of Jio Platforms IPO
headlines.summary: Jio Platforms IPO will commence its subscription from Oct 21 to 23. The price band for the IPO is fixed at ₹1,065 to ₹1,119 apiece to raise ₹30,203 crore, making it India's largest IPO to date. Ahead of the Jio IPO, shares of Airtel also drew attention as investors compare two telecom giants on key metrics like ARPU, revenue growth and valuations.
